context.transcript:
We hope you're enjoying your flight with Light Speed Airlines this morning.
If I can have your attention for one moment, I'd like to tell you about a special promotion we're offering.
This month only, when you sign up for our Light Speed Airlines rewards program, you'll be entered into a contest to win two round-trip tickets to Paris!
Enrolling in the rewards program is a very simple process, and the brochure in your seat-back pocket explains how to do it.
And now, flight attendants will be coming around with a selection of snacks.
context.transcript_translation:
我们希望您今天早上乘坐 Light Speed Airlines 的航班愉快。
如果我能占用大家一点时间，我想告诉大家一个我们正在提供的特别促销活动。
本月期间，只要您注册我们的 Light Speed Airlines 奖励计划，您就有机会参加一次抽奖，赢取两张往返巴黎的机票！
加入奖励计划非常简单，您座位靠背上的宣传册解释了如何操作。
现在，空乘人员将带着一些零食巡视各位。
